title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: Master FOB Audience Cassette > Nak CM300 mics > Sony D5: master cassetteplayed back via a Nakamichi DR-1 > HHB 850 > EAC for DAE to Harddrive >CEP > CDWave > CDRWin > Yamaha CR8424 CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience FOB capture of a high‑energy 1982 Portland show with smoking Touch of Grey, Estimated > Eyes, Spanish Jam and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid front‑of‑house (FOB) audience tape that conveys the crowd’s excitement while remaining clear enough to enjoy the band’s playing.  The show itself is lauded for its fire‑filled second set – highlighted by Touch of Grey, Estimated > Eyes, Spanish Jam into The Other One, High Time and Sugar Magnolia – with Jerry “on fire” and Phil delivering a thunderous space bomb.  Minor audio quirks (a slightly muffled piano mic) do not detract from the overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: The overwhelming majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars praising both performance and recording; only a few note minor flaws, yielding an average well above 4.5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house audience tape captures crowd energy and is generally clear; occasional muffled piano due to missing mic, but overall crisp enough for listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds nicely into a legendary second set with seamless transitions (Spanish Jam into The Other One, then into Good Morning/Daylight). Energy stays high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "on fire"; highlighted delicate high‑note lick in Touch of Grey and overall stellar solo work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Very active, delivering a "space bomb" and powerful bass thunder during the second set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's piano has an '82 country‑western tone; mic was missing for part of the show.
